spans.s:
n. (-चं)
1 Purification by ablution, &c. from personal defilement.
2 Purification at given periods from defilement caused by the death of a relation, &c.
3 The state or property of freedom from defilement, purity, cleanness.
E.
शुचि purity, अण् aff.

f. (-धिः)
The rules of purification after defilement by the death of a relation, &c.
E.
शौच, and बिधि precept.

m. (-रः)
A rule of purification, the mode in which the person is to be cleansed by ablution, &c. after voiding any excrement or contracting any impurity.
E.
शौच purification, and आचार rule, rite.

m. (-यः)
A washerman.
E.
शुचि cleaning, ढक् aff.

mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु)
Wishing or intending to be purified.
E.
शौच, and इप्सु desirous.

m. (-चिः)
A tailor.
E.
सूची a needle, इञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A tailor.
E.
सूची a needle, and ठक् aff.
